subject: Stratify POC: engineer-paired architecture lab — scheduling and scope
messages:
From: Asha Gupta <asha@stratify.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Murphy <ryan.murphy@stratify.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive & engineer pairing

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the discovery call today. We got good alignment on goals for the POC: throughput at 75 req/s, 90th-percentile latency under 220ms for our 512-token average, and predictable cost for steady-state traffic.

We'd like to move to an engineer-paired technical deep-dive where your inference runtime engineer(s) can pair with our infra and ML engineers to validate topology and run a short smoke test. Two asks from our side:
- Can you cover quantization strategy and KV-cache behavior for conversational workloads?
- We prefer a 90-minute lab with an attendant runbook and a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can iterate on.

Proposed week: Oct 19–22. Our team is in PST (SF) and also EMEA — if you can propose slots with timezone labels that would be great.

Please loop in whoever from Redwood should be on the call (runtime engineer + pre-sales SE). Also share any pre-reads you want us to review.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Gupta
Director of Platform Engineering | Stratify.ai
asha@stratify.ai

Attachment: discovery-notes-summary.txt (attached to original discovery export)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha@stratify.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive & engineer pairing

Hi Asha —

Great to hear — super aligned on the scope. Happy to run a 90-minute paired lab focused on: topology (single vs. multi-node), batching/latency tradeoffs, quantization profiles + accuracy checks, and KV cache behavior during multi-turn chat.

Two tentative slots (all listed in PDT / converted to your local times if needed):
- Tue Oct 20, 09:30–11:00 PDT (12:30–14:00 EDT)
- Wed Oct 21, 13:00–14:30 PDT (16:00–17:30 EDT)

If neither works we can also do Thu Oct 22 morning.

Sooj and Marcus are copied — Soojin will lead the architecture breakdown; Marcus will pair on runtime kernels & profiling. I'll attach the pre-sales architecture deck and the MAP workbook for your legal/procurement review.

Pre-reads attached: pre-sales-arch-deck.pdf, MAP-stratify.xlsx

If you confirm a slot I will create a calendar event with the pairing details and a short agenda (30 min architecture + 45–55 min hands-on + 10–15 min next steps).

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.com

Thanks — either slot works for us, but we have an internal stakeholder (VP of ML) available only on Tue Oct 20 from 12:30–1:30pm EDT. Can we tighten the agenda to 60–75 minutes and prioritize architecture + quantization demos in the first 45 minutes so the VP can join that portion?

Also: can you explicitly confirm someone on your side who has run-time kernel/quantization experience and can walk through a perf profile? If Marcus is available to pair on that, that'd be perfect.

Finally, we'll want the MAP workbook filled out at a high level before the session so our procurement/legal can flag anything early.

—Ryan

- 12:30–12:45 EDT: Architecture & routing (Soojin)
- 12:45–13:05 EDT: Quantization approach + perf profile (Marcus)
- 13:05–13:40 EDT: Paired lab / smoke test (Marcus + Stratify engineers)
- 13:40–13:45 EDT: Next steps / MAP review (Dylan)

Marcus will lead the quantization + kernel walkthrough. I've created a tentative calendar event and included a short pairing checklist and the shared MAP link. Please confirm attendee list and whether legal should be on the call or we queue a 15-min follow-up.
